parsed_json.up: Select distinct molecule ChEMBL IDs and canonical SMILES for compounds tested in assays against target CHEMBL1824. Join activities to assays and target_dictionary, filtering on assays.assay_organism = 'Homo sapiens' and target_dictionary.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1824'. Join molecule_dictionary and compound_structures via activities.molregno to retrieve chembl_id and canonical_smiles. Return columns compound_chembl_id and canonical_smiles. Sort by compound_chembl_id and canonical_smiles.
